newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia sees 90,000 new companies in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Australia sees 90,000 new companies in 96/97.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) regulatory body said on Friday it expected more than 90,000 companies would incorporate in Australia in the year to June 30, 1997.

"Trends in company incorporations during the past 10 months show an increase of 20.84 percent over the same priod last year," ASC chairman Alan Cameron said at a presentation ceremony marking the incorporation of Australia's one millionth company.
"This strong trend indicates that the 1996/97 financial year will become a new record year for Australian company incorporations with annual incorporations expected to exceed 90,000," Cameron said.
Cameron said the figures could indicate that business in Australia was doing well and the economic climate may be right for people setting up their own company.
